historical_record.description: The property held a two-story, single-family dwelling.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition permit for a two-story, single-family dwelling.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the construction of a three-story, two-unit building with conditions.
